title: Spora Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for plugin.json — the manifest every Spora plugin must ship.

slug.description: Unique machine-readable identifier for this plugin. Used as the component key in schema_versions and as the required prefix for migration filenames. Must be stable across releases.

class.description: Fully-qualified class name of the plugin entry point. Must implement Spora\Plugins\PluginInterface.

description.description: Short human-readable description of the plugin, surfaced by the inventory UI.

icon.description:
Icon for the plugin in the inventory UI. Two forms are accepted (resolution order: bundled name → raw path). The frontend falls back to a bundled "puzzle" icon if the value is empty (or whitespace-only) or doesn't match either form.

  • Bundled name: a kebab-case identifier from the Spora palette (e.g. "puzzle", "brain", "lightbulb", "compass", "globe"). See docs/07_plugins.md § Bundled icons for the full list.
  • Raw SVG path: a single `d` string. Smallest in JSON, but limited to single-path icons (compose multi-shape glyphs as subpaths by repeating `M`).

    The host's resolver (spora-components `src/icons/Icon.vue`, `SVG_PATH_LEAD`) accepts the value as a path only when it starts with a moveto immediately followed by a digit: `M` + optional whitespace + a digit (`M15.39…`, `M 15 4`), or `m` + optional whitespace + an optional `-` + a digit (`m-3 6 2 2`, `m3 6 2 2`, `m 3 6`). Nothing else is accepted as the first command — `L`, `H`, `V`, `C`, `S`, `Q`, `T`, `A`, `Z` (and their lowercase forms) all fall through to the bundled `puzzle` icon silently, with no validation error. This is deliberate and matches the SVG spec, which requires a path to begin with a moveto: those other letters are not legal first commands, so a path starting with one would be rejected by the browser's SVG validator and the icon still would not render. The digit requirement exists for the same reason — without it a kebab-case name such as `layout-template` or `map-pin` would be mistaken for path data.

    Known host-side gap, recorded rather than worked around: the same rule rejects a leading-dot first coordinate (`M.5.5`, `m.5.5`), which is legal SVG and what many icon sets emit (Heroicons, for one). Such a value falls back to `puzzle`. Write `M0.5 0.5…` instead, or use a bundled name. The fix belongs in `spora-components` (widen `SVG_PATH_LEAD` to allow a decimal-leading coordinate); it is not applied here because that resolver is a sanitiser-adjacent surface.

Full <svg>...</svg> blobs are no longer accepted — the frontend's Icon component used to sanitise them through DOMPurify's SVG profile, but historical mXSS bypasses in that profile motivated dropping the v-html path entirely. Plugin authors should ship a single `d` string.

Defaults to "puzzle" when omitted.

accent.description: Tile accent colour for the plugin's app tile. Mirror the enum in the host's `tileAccent()` map. Precedence: PHP `App::accent()` > this field > `"primary"`. Unknown / missing values fall back to `"primary"` silently.
